scope: Unregistered DLL factory activation; real Windows thread/document/context/range and edit sessions backed by a visible plain-text ITextStoreACP host. Host forwards key/focus callbacks to production sinks; actual Rime IPC and native candidate/menu windows.

checks.name: native v0.5 candidate exposes current candidates and four accessible tools
TSF candidate BSTR contains no embedded terminator
ordinary nonhighlighted candidate action commits Chinese through TSF once
retained accessibility object cannot act on a destroyed view
TSF UI element selection and finalize share the Chinese commit path
F2 opens separate definition without an edit or candidate resize
Escape closes definition while preserving composition
explicit English still commits exactly once after closing definition
learning tool preserves page selection and composition through real IPC
real candidate window contracts while retaining width and top
learning-off accessible candidates omit English immediately
learning-off rejects explicit English without losing composition
learning-off preference is persisted locally
learning reenable preserves page and persists enabled state
Chinese selection remains correct after learning animation
externally saved learning preference updates the existing service session
externally reenabled learning restores English on the next composition
alternate shortcut disables the default Lua English chord
configured Alt Enter commits complete English through TSF
settings shortcut during composition preserves pending input
document focus change closes definition and old candidate view
new document accepts Chinese after definition focus change
visible candidate and definition close on service loss without a key
disconnected alternate English action is never replayed
native UI actions respect all actual TSF edit locks
retained accessibility reference keeps the DLL alive safely
releasing accessibility permits complete TSF DLL teardown

limits: Programmatic key/focus callbacks; not Windows routing of an installed TIP or physical keyboard/mouse observations
Native menu open/cancel/focus/disconnect tested; physical selection of its English command remains unverified
No registration, installation, profile activation or input settings changes
x86 isolated service; test-only lexicon; no complete installable product package
